sections.description: Vertical flex layout with gap between children and block/inline padding.

sections.title: Prose
sections.description: Narrower max-width for readable long-form text (640px / 80 units).

children.text: Prose content is constrained to a comfortable reading width. Long paragraphs stay readable without requiring the eye to travel too far across the screen.
This works well for articles, documentation, and form layouts.

sections.title: Flush
sections.description: No padding, only gap between children. Useful when the parent handles padding.

sections.description: Content inside a centered container for a typical page layout.
